In how many years did total US CO2 exceed 6,000 Mt? (A) 13 (B) 4 (C) 8. Answer with just the letter.
US CO2 by Fuel Source (1990-2022)

arguments.script: (() => { const vals=[...document.querySelectorAll('#chart path[aria-label]')].map(p=>p.getAttribute('aria-label')).map(s=>{const m=s.match(/Year: (\d+); CO2 \(million tonnes\): ([\d.-]+)/); return m?{year:+m[1],value:+m[2]}:null}).filter(Boolean); let sums={}; for(const x of vals)sums[x.year]=(sums[x.year]||0)+x.value; return Object.entries(sums).filter(([y,v])=>v>6000).map(([y,v])=>[y,+v.toFixed(1)]); })()
